payload.text: The Brennecke Institute developed a thalliline-doped sodium-flow battery intended to reduce electrolyte crossover, a key aging mechanism. An independent audit retracted the initial cycle-life claim and established 8,400 cycles as the corrected governing figure. The cell delivers 148 Wh/kg gravimetric energy density, with a projected stack-level cost of $61/kWh at 500 MWh manufacturing scale. Its operating limit is a 4 °C floor, below which the thalliline dopant precipitates and cycling must stop.

FLAGS: Source C contains conflicting cycle-life values: “4,800 cycles” and “8,400 cycles as the corrected, governing cycle-life figure.”
